steps.observation:
I have filed evidence records for the four clause categories present in the executed Supply Agreement. 

Regarding **most_favored_nation**: The executed Supply Agreement (Section 4) explicitly states, "No most-favored-customer or most-favored-nation pricing commitment is made under this Agreement." Although the non-binding term sheet notes this was proposed, the term sheet is explicitly not to be used, and the executed agreement affirmatively disclaims any MFN commitment. Per the rules, I correctly did **not** file a record for this category since it is absent from the executed agreement.
